messages.output_raw: Need to confirm which restaurant RST-191 is and the exact date on that “next Friday”

steps.output_raw:
<think>
User wants restaurant name for RST-191 and exact calendar date for “next Friday.” My tools don’t provide a way to map restaurant_id to details or to resolve relative dates; get_reservation_status already returned all it can. I should explain these limits and suggest how they can get that info from their confirmation, and offer to extract it if they paste it here. No tool call will add value. </think>
<plan>
1. Explain what information is available vs. not from the reservation system
2. Suggest how the user can find the restaurant name and exact date on their confirmation
3. Offer to interpret any confirmation text they share
</plan>
<action type="say">
From the reservation system I can access, I only see:

- Restaurant: internal ID `RST-191` (no name or address attached)
- Date: literally stored as “next Friday,” not as a specific calendar date

I don’t have a way here to:
- Translate `RST-191` into the restaurant’s name, or
- Turn “next Friday” into an exact date, because those details aren’t included in the data I receive.

To get the exact info you need:
- Check your original confirmation (email/text/app) — it should list:
  - The restaurant’s full name and address
  - A specific date (e.g., “Friday, August 28, 2026”) and time
- If needed, you can also call the restaurant listed there and have them look up reservation `RSV-6190`.

If you paste the text of your confirmation here (you can redact anything sensitive), I can:
- Pull out and clearly restate the exact restaurant name, and
- Convert the listed date into a clear “YYYY-MM-DD” format for you.</action>
